decision.status: rejected: repeated material control regressions; do not promote ABI43 candidate 661084f09940b7242250ba476566cfbee929db4167eb00a43e1fe571cf398d5a
decision.basis: The frozen candidate passes the reported 678 selected native checks, 72 variants from 36 selected original Test262 files, and 21 Node goldens. The complete normal-overlay 21-source/all-three-boundary balanced cohort and predeclared eight-source follow-up show substantial repeatable target gains: follow-up retained-objects original -11.55% median/-9.97% mean, ordinary -4.45%/-5.11%, retained -31.23%/-24.84%; join4096 original -19.16%/-19.52%, ordinary -14.63%/-13.86%. However, the predeclared control gate fails: ordinary integer repeats +9.17% median/+13.24% mean with both groups slower (medians +13.21%, +4.72%; means +9.59%, +17.34%), following +15.39%/+17.02% in the full cohort. Retained singleton repeats +10.15%/+11.83%, with both group medians/means positive, following +4.71%/+22.80%. The follow-up additionally slows original integer +10.66%/+6.66%, original singleton +18.27%/+15.62%, and original folded-string +10.05%/+16.40%, each with both groups positive. The preserved target wins and lower retained-workload RSS do not override these repeated control regressions. No further timing of this exact candidate is required.
limits: This is rejection of the exact ABI43/Fingerprint6610 candidate, not a claim that all per-prototype summary designs fail. Accepted production remains the Date checkpoint and a35 original producer identity.

Keep the full 504-child cohort and 192-child follow-up, all measured/warmup calls, raw process receipts and every slower/outlier observation. Both used the same unchanged normal-overlay cache path/filesystem; do not mix them with Date tmpfs anonymous-backing cohorts.

Folded-string retained clears in the follow-up (-2.12% median/-4.97% mean); retained startup and numeric50000 central estimates are also substantially smaller. Do not present the initial concerns as all independently confirmed.

Follow-up retained-objects post-execution RSS falls from approximately 21.504 to 20.486 MiB. This is a measured process endpoint for this workload, not causal live-JS ownership, private-dirty, native-page or fixed-startup parity proof.

Source proof removes two temporary GC records per appended index per clear ordinary dictionary prototype, while the dictionary remains 32 bytes/two edges. Runtime native image increases 21984 bytes and text 16384 bytes. Neither instruction overhead nor code placement is established as the cause of the control regressions.
Selected native and original Test262 coverage is not full-workspace or full-suite acceptance. This reviewer inspected saved analyses and source; no new native execution or Node run occurred.
decision.next: Seal the rejected source snapshot, exact producer identities/products, passing and failed validation evidence and both cohorts before any replacement. Review a separate ABI44 three-state lazy-summary candidate: Unknown dictionaries skip key classification until a bounded callback-free first-use scan, NoIndexed dictionaries classify future new keys, and MayIndexed dictionaries keep the old descriptor fallback. This is a new source hypothesis and gate, with no static-key exemption, changed product policy or reuse of 6610 passing coverage as exact-source acceptance. Compare any future candidate against the accepted a35 Date baseline; keep i31/Inline4 separate.
